svg.title: Molecule of the day: Caffeine
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Caffeine while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as -0.64.
svg.text: MW 194.2 · cLogP -1.03 · TPSA 61.8 · HBD 0 · HBA 3 · RotB 0
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
